role: The base of every structure generator: the per-type structureMap of starts, the candidate walk that tests and builds starts around a generated chunk, the per-chunk block pass, point-in-structure queries for spawn lists, the nearest-structure search for eyes of ender, and saving starts to the world's structure data.
scope_reason: Every overworld and Nether structure goes through it. The save-writing side is deferred: native never writes save files; Java writes every checkpoint (product decision, not a gap for the GPU or the golden chain; triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md). The read side is a real item (B4).

notes: Starts are malloc'd pointer trees (struct start -> struct piece*) grown with realloc; a GPU port needs them flattened. Gate not re-run for this record. The disk half is n/a (lane/idxworld): every save this game makes is the oracle's (a checkpoint's save, session.sh's Save and Quit through Java: AGENTS.md 'Playing a full game'), and the native engine reads what it wrote (region.c for the overworld's region files, the snapshot's saved chunks for DIM-1 and DIM1, structures.json, villages.nbt, worldinfo.nbt, player_server.nbt); writing those files natively is the deferred product work of the 2026-09-25 triage (SPEC.md NEXT, '11 deferred save-writing'; out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md, 'Deferred, not noise'). Within a session nothing reads a save back: an unloaded chunk waits whole in the in-memory region store (sr_store_chunk) with what writeChunkToNBT keeps of it (the entities it saves, in section order; the pending ticks relative to the world time), and a reload restores exactly that (the persist-* and play-reload recordings). A start's saved state reaches the native engine from the oracle's snapshot: structures.json lists each MapGenStructure's starts in the structureMap's order with every component's box, HPos, VCount and once-set flags (populate_restore_pieces), so a start rebuilt from its seeded chunk holds what the saved NBT held (struct-cp-s42, persist-village-s42).
